producer: control-expert, 2026-11-26, edition 8 early-handover fix design (record only, offline)

columns_e01_exposure.diag_handovers: [[t_prev_start_s, prev_leg, t_diag_start_s, diag_leg], ...]: consecutive starts where the later leg is the diagonal of the earlier (FL-RR, FR-RL); t relative to the event for event rows
columns_e01_exposure.early: event row and a diagonal start <= 0.45 s after the event (dynamics 4.6 (b) criterion)

columns_e01_rerun_handover.t_handover_s: first period whose active re-approach changes from leg p to DIAG[p] (t from the event) [s]
columns_e01_rerun_handover.L_diag_at_handover_kN: lower load estimate of the diagonal at that period (u11 load_<leg>_kN) [kN]
columns_e01_rerun_handover.HB_defers: L < start level 1.4 F_min (candidate H-1 defers: no landed sample since the end)
columns_e01_rerun_handover.L_diag_next5_kN_recorded: next five recorded L of the diagonal on the OLD trajectory (not a prediction)

exactness: the first handover decision is exact (commands identical up to that period); everything after it changes the trajectory and is not replayed
